learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to move! Today we will learn how to throw a ball properly and catch it safely with both hands.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Keep your eyes on your target. Step forward with one foot, swing your arm, and throw the ball straight to your friend!
Watch the ball carefully as it comes towards you. Bring both hands together like a basket and grab it tight!
Always make sure your friend is ready before you throw the ball. Take turns, play safely, and cheer for everyone in the game!

fun_activity.title: 🎈 The Magic Balloon Toss
fun_activity.instructions: Blow up a balloon and toss it high in the air. Try to clap your hands once before catching it without letting it touch the ground!

quick_recap: ⭐ Always keep your eyes on the ball while playing.
⭐ Make a soft cup shape with your hands to catch the ball easily and safely.
